"""Show the lexical search answer's ranked list and hits for the identifier questions (results only)."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from gov.retrieval import lexical

root = Path(sys.argv[1])
for question in sys.argv[2:]:
    answer = lexical.search(root, question, refresh=False)
    print("QUESTION", repr(question), "available", answer.get("available"), "keys", sorted(answer))
    for chunk in answer.get("ranked", []):
        print("  ranked", chunk.get("path"), chunk.get("start_line"), chunk.get("end_line"),
              "exact", chunk.get("exact"), "bm25", chunk.get("bm25"))
    for hit in answer.get("hits", []):
        print("  hit", hit.get("path"), hit.get("line"), repr(hit.get("text")))
